item.title: Taskforce Participant Perspectives | Hannah Hope from Wellcome
item.description: “From my position within a funder, our interests are focused on improving research discoverability across a range of research outputs and enhancing our ability to understand the reach and use of those outputs. We want to contribute the enrichments we have made within our systems with others in the community.”
